pages.title: About
pages.content:
Kanjo College was founded in 2009 at 14 Corder Street, Northgate, Halden, by Principal Helena Marsh. It began with two evening classes in bookkeeping and now teaches four papers by day and by evening.

Classes are capped at sixteen learners, and every term follows the same twelve-week rhythm.

pages.title: Papers
pages.content:
Four papers, each 36 class hours over a twelve-week term: Financial Accounting, Management Accounting, Tax & Payroll, and Audit & Assurance.

Each paper includes a week 6 practice paper and a week 9 full mock paper.

pages.title: Term calendar
pages.content:
Three terms a year: Spring from 12 January, Summer from 20 April and Autumn from 14 September. Day classes meet Monday and Wednesday 09:30–15:30; evening classes Tuesday and Thursday 18:30–21:00.

Route of a term: Enrol, Weeks 1–4, Mock paper, Exam week, Results.

pages.title: Lecturers
pages.content: Helena Marsh (principal, Financial Accounting), Tomás Ferreira (Financial Accounting), Grace Okonjo (Tax & Payroll), Pieter van Dalen (Audit & Assurance), Amira Haddad (Management Accounting), Samuel Kwan (exams office) and Leila Brandt (learner adviser).

pages.title: Fees & funding
pages.content:
Placement chat and exercise: Free. Foundation paper, one term: $640. Intermediate paper, one term: $780. Advanced paper, one term: $920. Mock paper day, stand-alone: $85.

A $150 deposit holds a place and counts toward the fee. Pay in three instalments without interest. Full refund before week 2.

pages.title: Taking a place
pages.content:
01 Placement chat (30 minutes, free). 02 Placement exercise (45 minutes, at college or online). 03 Choose papers and timetable. 04 Pay the $150 deposit and enrol.

Leila Brandt, our learner adviser, will arrange your chat.

pages.title: Stories
pages.content: Marta Ruiz moved from bookkeeping toward an assistant accountant role on the evening route. Daniel Mensah left retail management on the day route. Priya Nair returned after parental leave, one paper per term.

pages.title: Contact
pages.content:
14 Corder Street, Northgate, Halden. Phone +1 555 0142. Office hours Mon–Fri 09:00–20:30, Sat 09:00–13:00, closed Sun.

To book a placement chat, call the office or visit during opening hours.

pages.title: Newsletter
pages.content: Term dates and timetable notices are posted under News. Visit the college office to join the mailing list.

posts.title: What the mock paper day is like
posts.excerpt: How the week 6 practice and week 9 mock prepare learners for exam week.
posts.content: Samuel Kwan runs both sittings. The week 6 practice paper is a gentle first run; the week 9 mock is a full paper under exam conditions, marked and returned before exam week.
